comment: Infinite keyframes animate a registered <angle> (0deg to 360deg in 4 s); the conic gradient's 'from' and a transform read it through var(): 90deg at 1 s, 180deg at 2 s, and 90deg again at 5 s (the second iteration). (The captures are at quarter turns: the edges of a bar at other angles are anti-aliased differently by the engine and Skia, which this fixture does not test.)
